profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer @ Allvue Systems | Software Infrastructure, Design
profile.summary: I love solving complex problems, designing cloud-native applications, and helping teams build great software. With experience leading teams, making technical decisions, and working directly with clients, I focus on both the big picture and the details. Whether it’s optimizing logistics, improving system design, or mentoring others, I aim to create impact and enjoy the process along the way.
